label: Form 1099-B box 4 withholding on a statement with no closed sale

fact_types.title: Whether the filer received a 2025 Form 1099-B or substitute statement that shows federal income tax withheld in box 4 and reports no closed sale, other than a statement whose box 4 you already entered, with or without a sale.

Federal income tax withheld in box 4 of 2025 Form 1099-B or substitute statements that report no closed sale, excluding any statement whose box 4 you already entered, with or without a sale. One nonnegative total for the return.
